profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, AI/ML at Carlsmed, Inc.
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer with a diverse background in tech, drug research & development, medical devices, and teaching, I bring a unique perspective to the table. I thrive on the challenge of working with modern web development technologies and have experience with both front-end and back-end development.

As an Adjunct Instructor, I have a passion for sharing my knowledge and experience with others, and I have found great joy in helping students achieve their full potential. Additionally, my experience as an Operations Manager has taught me the importance of effective communication, teamwork, and project management.

I have developed a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle and the importance of delivering high-quality products that meet customer needs.
